Pizza Ride

Avondale Estates, GA

Pizza Ride is a road group ride in Avondale Estates, GA. It meets every Thursday, 6:00 pm, starting at Art Lot. Pace: moderate to strenuous, several paces.

About the Pizza Ride group ride

One of the long-running Atlanta road rides. Leaves the Art Lot in Avondale Estates Thursday evenings and splits into groups by pace and distance. Runs year-round. Pizza afterward is the point.
